name: Berggasthaus Stimmlach
beschreibung: Berggasthaus Stimmlach is a traditional inn located in the municipality of Westendorf in the Brixental valley. The property is run as a family-managed establishment with a cozy dining parlor. The rooms are simply and practically furnished. The kitchen serves authentic Tyrolean specialties such as dumplings and Kaiserschmarrn. In winter, the inn is located close to the slopes of the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area. In summer, the house serves as an ideal base for hikers and mountain bikers. A beer garden is open during the warmer months. Accommodation is tailored for stays with half board.
